ops.en: The KNOWLEDGE verb's carnal debut — the tree's verb (daat) domesticated into the corpus's idiom for union: what the eating delivered, the marriage now carries. Perfect tense, background onset.
The FIRST BIRTH — 3:16's sentence term (teldi) becomes narrative event one chapter later.

The corpus's first BIRTH-ETYMOLOGY, in the MOTHER's mouth: Kayin from kaniti ('I have ACQUIRED') — the naming authority now hers (the man named her, 3:20; she names the child). And her speech carries SOLO-YHWH's FIRST TOKEN (gen_08's census: the compound ends at 3:24) — the first human ever to say the divine name is Chavah, at a birth: 'a man WITH YHWH' (et = 'with', lemma 854 — not the object mar…

The second birth arrives ALREADY-BROTHERED (et-ACHIV et-Havel — 'his brother' precedes the name) and UNNAMED BY ANYONE: no speech, no etymology — Hevel ('vapor, breath') is a noun the text never glosses [OPEN]: the first name whose meaning is carried only by its word. The brother-word (ach) debuts here — x7 in this span: the unit is the corpus's brother-density peak.

Two standing professions (participles, TIR-031), chiastically ordered: the younger shepherds; the elder works the GROUND — 3:23's exile job inherited as the firstborn's trade. The division of labor is the corpus's first — and the offering scene will run along its seam.

Cain brings from his trade: fruit of the (cursed) ground. Onkelos: tikruvta — the korban vocabulary (dual-track).

Abel's portion names two future institutions in one clause: BEKHOROT ('firstlings' — the firstborn laws ahead, Exod 13) and CHELEV ('fat' — first token; Exod 23:18; Lev 3:16 'all fat is the LORD'S'): the altar law's choicest-parts doctrine, here a shepherd's instinct.

The instrument has changed: not the week's tov, not Eden's silence — SHA'AH ('gazed/regarded'; 3 corpus tokens: 4:4, 4:5, Exod 5:9). The machine records a PASS with the new oracle word: person AND offering regarded, in that order (el-Hevel VE-el-minchato — the giver before the gift; the chain builds on the order; named-only). ANGER's first token (charah — 'burned hot'), at MAXIMUM on arrival (me'od — day 6's superlative), with the corpus's first fallen FACE (the panim thread the span runs to its end: fallen face -> hidden from Your face -> out from before the Face).

The docket formula adapts: Eden's questions hunted facts (where / who told / what); this one interrogates an EMOTION, twice (lamah x2) — the corpus's first pastoral question, before any crime exists. The counsel follows unasked.

The good branch pays SE'ET ('uplift' — the nasa root): the lev_13 A-join's source verse — the intake taxonomy's lead mark-name is born here …

[OPEN]). Sin enters the corpus as a predator with an address.

The scene is BA-SADEH — 2:5's field. The armed handler's word (mot, gen_08) remains unexecuted by heaven: the first actual death is man-made — the handler-delta's sharpest edge, recorded at gen_11, now sourced.
